summary: This EOB shows one MRI service on May 14, 2026. The plan's allowed price was $850. Because you had not yet met your $1,500 yearly deductible, the entire allowed amount goes to your deductible — the plan paid $0 on this claim. The provider billed $1,800, but your plan only recognizes $850 as fair. The $950 difference is written off by the provider and you do not owe it. After this service, you will have used $1,050 of your deductible ($200 before + $850 from this claim).

lines.explanation: You owe $850 for this MRI. This amount is applied to your yearly $1,500 deductible [CODE-PR-1: "PR-1 means this amount was applied to your deductible, the amount you pay each year before the plan starts sharing costs."]. The provider billed $1,800, but your plan's allowed price is $850. The $950 difference (called CO-45) is written off by the provider [CODE-CO-45: "CO-45 means the provider billed more than the rate they agreed to with the plan. The difference is written off by the provider. Members do not owe CO-45 amounts for in-network care."], so you do not owe that part. Once you meet your full deductible, the plan will begin to share the cost of covered services.

CO-45 means the provider billed more than the rate they agreed to with the plan. The difference is written off by the provider. Members do not owe CO-45 amounts for in-network care.

actions: Verify that Lakeside Imaging's bill matches this EOB — they should only bill you $850, not the $1,800 billed amount. If they bill you for more, contact their billing office with a copy of this EOB.
Track your deductible progress: you have now used $1,050 of your $1,500 deductible. You have $450 remaining before the plan begins to share costs.
Note: MRI services may require prior authorization from your plan before the appointment. If you have a future imaging need, ask your doctor's office or call your plan to confirm approval first.
